longDescription:
When something goes wrong with your plumbing, you need it fixed fast — not in a few days, not after three phone calls, but now. KA Plumbing provides reliable plumbing repair services across all of Auckland, from the North Shore to South Auckland.

Kurt is a fully certified plumber who arrives equipped to handle the most common plumbing repairs in a single visit. faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a plumbing emergency in Auckland?
faqs.a: For emergencies like burst pipes or flooding, Kurt aims to arrive within 30-60 minutes across Auckland, including the North Shore, Central, and West Auckland.

faqs.q: Do you charge a call-out fee for plumbing repairs?
faqs.a: No call-out fee for standard plumbing repairs during business hours. Emergency after-hours callouts may have a small surcharge, always disclosed upfront.

faqs.q: Can you repair all types of pipes?
faqs.a: Yes — copper, PEX, polybutylene, galvanised, and PVC. Kurt carries common fittings on the van for fast same-day repairs.

heroSubheadline: No one should start their day with a cold shower. Kurt carries common parts on the van for fast same-day hot water fixes.
introHeading: Auckland's Trusted Hot Water Cylinder Specialists
longDescription:
When your hot water goes out, you want it back today — not next week. KA Plumbing provides fast hot water cylinder repair and replacement services across all of Auckland, from the North Shore to South Auckland.

Kurt carries common hot water cylinder parts on the van and can often restore your hot water the same day. faqs.q: Can you fix my hot water the same day?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Kurt carries common cylinder parts and elements on the van. If a replacement is needed, we can often source and install within 24 hours.

faqs.q: What hot water brands do you install?
faqs.a: We install and service all major brands including Rheem, Rinnai, Dux, and Aquamax. Kurt will recommend the best option for your household.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my hot water cylinder?

title: Drain Laying
seoTitle: Drain Layer Auckland | Certified Drain Laying Services | KA Plumbing LTD
seoDescription: Certified drain layer in Auckland. Stormwater, wastewater, new drainage, and repairs. Council-compliant work across the North Shore and all Auckland. Free quotes.
heroHeadline: Certified Drain Laying Services Across Auckland
heroSubheadline: As a certified drain layer, Kurt is licensed to design, install, and repair drainage systems that meet council requirements.
introHeading: Licensed Drain Layer — Compliant, Consented, Built to Last
longDescription:
Drainage work is one area where cutting corners costs you dearly. As a certified drain layer, Kurt is fully licensed to design, install, and repair stormwater and wastewater drainage systems that meet Auckland Council requirements.

Whether you're developing a new section in Albany, replacing old clay pipes in Devonport, adding drainage to a renovation in Takapuna, or dealing with a blocked drain in Glenfield, KA Plumbing has you covered. Every drain laying job is properly documented, inspected, and built to code — protecting your property and keeping you compliant.

Our drain laying services include new stormwater and wastewater drainage installation, replacement of old clay, earthenware, and concrete pipes, drainage for new builds and subdivisions, drainage modifications during renovations, blocked drain clearing and diagnosis, CCTV drain inspection and reporting, and soak pit and stormwater management solutions.

Kurt's dual certification as both a plumber and drain layer means your project needs only one contractor. That means fewer scheduling conflicts, better coordination, and lower costs. From small residential repairs on the North Shore to large-scale drainage work across Auckland, the standard of work is always the same — council-compliant, properly consented, and built to last.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a plumber and a drain layer?
faqs.a: A plumber handles water supply and internal waste pipes. A drain layer handles external drainage — stormwater and wastewater systems outside the building. Kurt holds both certifications.

faqs.q: Do I need council consent for drainage work?
faqs.a: Most drainage work in Auckland requires a building consent. As a certified drain layer, Kurt handles the documentation and ensures all work meets Auckland Council requirements.
Yes — from simple blockages to complex root intrusion. We also offer CCTV drain inspections to identify the exact cause before any digging.
